data_note: Candidate scan uses public US and Canadian Yahoo Finance activity/gainer screeners; it is not an exhaustive scan. Daily price history may be delayed and Yahoo endpoints are unofficial. SEC annual fundamentals are included only when an exact SEC ticker match is available; other issuers are explicitly marked market-data-only. SEC figures are annual reported values, not real-time data. Prices are in local trading currencies.
strategy: Multi-factor score 0–100. Technical score: 25% trend alignment, 20% 50-day return, 20% 20-day return, 10% 5-day return, 10% relative volume, and 15% liquidity, less a volatility penalty. Where exact SEC annual fundamentals are available, the main-stock score blends 60% filing-based financial health/growth/profitability with 40% technical conditions; penny stocks blend 30% fundamentals with 70% technical conditions. Without SEC fundamentals, the score is technical-only and is explicitly labelled. Main stocks require 20-day average dollar volume of at least $1 million; penny stocks must be $0.05–$10 with at least $100,000 average daily dollar volume.
